board.title: Task Board
board.subtitle_one: {{count}} task · drag and drop to move; dropping on “In progress” starts the work
board.subtitle_other: {{count}} tasks · drag and drop to move; dropping on “In progress” starts the work
board.emptyHint: Describe some work to the lead in the chat on the left, or add a new task.

card.waitsForHint: Autopilot starts it once these are done; you can still start it yourself.
card.raceHint: Race mode: two members worked on the same task; the lead keeps the better attempt.
card.waitsMergeHint: The task it builds on is done, but its changes aren't merged into the project folder yet (open that task: "Review changes and merge").
card.heldHint: Autopilot doesn't start held tasks. Start it yourself, or move it back to To do.
card.undecided: Your decision: the lead couldn't decide
card.notMerged: Not merged into the folder yet
card.simulated: Demo simulation — no real work was done
card.reviewSimulated: Review simulated — nothing was really checked

startGuard.title: An earlier step isn't finished
startGuard.body: {{key}} waits for {{keys}}, whose result it was meant to build on. Start it anyway?

drawer.noMessages: No messages yet. You can leave the agent a note; it is taken into account on the next run.
drawer.notePlaceholder: Add a note to the task…
drawer.mergeHint: Merge this task's branch into the project folder (it waited, e.g. because of uncommitted changes there).
drawer.acceptanceChecked: The lead's assessment (from the report and the tool record; the lead doesn't run tests)
drawer.heldHint: It won't start again on its own. The earlier attempt may have changed files or other systems: check what it left, then press “Try again” — the agent is told about that attempt and checks first.
drawer.reviewIssueHint: The worker's report is kept. Retry just the review (the worker doesn't run again), or decide yourself: move it to Done, or back to To do with a note.
drawer.reviewPending: A review of this task is already queued or running.
drawer.approvalHint: Awaiting approval: nothing is done until you approve. Approve or decline it under "Running work" on the left; to stop being asked, turn off "Require approval" in the agent's permissions.
drawer.simulatedWork: The latest run of this task was a Demo simulation: no file was edited and no test ran; the steps and file names in its report are examples.
drawer.simulated: The latest run and review of this task were Demo simulations: no file was edited, no test ran, and the acceptance marks and review note are not a real check.
drawer.simulatedReview: The work was real, but the lead's review was a Demo simulation: the acceptance marks and review note are not a real check. Look at the changes yourself.

new.title: New task
new.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Add a theme picker to the settings page
new.filesHint: the agent doing the task can read them
new.noAgents: No assignable agents in the project — the lead distributes the task itself.
new.acceptancePlaceholder: One per line, e.g. Tests pass · UI text in Turkish · Don't touch the db/ folder
new.acceptanceHint: Optional. The assignee sees them; the lead checks each one and sends the task back if one isn't met.

changes.title: What changed?
changes.truncated: The diff is longer; the rest is cut off here.

mergeReview.title: {{key}} — changes to merge
mergeReview.body: This is what merging brings into the project folder. Nothing is merged until you say so; closing this changes nothing.
mergeReview.none: The working copy has no changes against the project.
mergeReview.unreadable: The changes could not be read, so nothing can be merged now.

doneGuard.title: Move a running task to Done?
doneGuard.bodyFolder: {{key}} is running. Moving it to Done stops the run. Nothing is undone: what the agent changed so far stays in the project folder, and the task counts as done by you, without the lead's review.
doneGuard.bodyWorktree: {{key}} is running. Moving it to Done stops the run. Nothing is undone and nothing is merged: the changes stay in the task's working copy, and the task counts as done by you, without the lead's review. Bring them into the project later with “Review changes and merge”; tasks that depend on it wait until then.
doneGuard.confirm: Stop it and move to Done

result.title: Result
result.simulated: Demo simulation: no real work was done, no command or test ran, nothing was checked.

runStatus.succeeded: The provider finished the run without an error (that doesn't mean the work is right)

result.byUser: You marked it done; no lead review
result.byLead: {{name}} approved it (reading the report and the tool record; the lead doesn't run tests)
result.bySimulatedReview: Simulated review (Demo) — nothing was really checked
result.undecided: The lead couldn't decide; it's your call
result.changesMerged_one: {{count}} file (+{{added}} −{{removed}}) · merged into the project folder
result.changesMerged_other: {{count}} files (+{{added}} −{{removed}}) · merged into the project folder
result.changesWaiting_one: {{count}} file (+{{added}} −{{removed}}) · in the working copy, not merged yet
result.changesWaiting_other: {{count}} files (+{{added}} −{{removed}}) · in the working copy, not merged yet
result.noFiles: No successful write with file tools is recorded
result.filesUnknown: This provider doesn't report the files it writes; look in the project folder
result.commandsUnknown: This provider gives no tool record: which tests ran is not known. Claims like "tests pass" in the report are the agent's own.
result.noCommands: No command ran — if the report says "tests pass", that is not verified.
result.commandsNote: From the tool record: ✓ finished · ✗ failed · ? no result recorded. Output in Logs.
result.reportCut: The report is longer than what the lead reads; the lead didn't see its end.
result.todoDecide: Approve it or send it back
result.todoFailed: A command failed and didn't succeed later: check the report and Logs
result.todoDenied: Something was refused: the work may be incomplete
result.todoOwnLook: Look at the changes yourself (nothing was really checked)
result.byLeadReportOnly: {{name}} approved it (reading only the report; this provider gives no tool record)
result.byLeadRace: {{name}} compared the two attempts' reports in the race and chose this one (the tool record isn't part of that comparison)
result.bySimulatedRace: Simulated race comparison (Demo) — nothing was really checked
result.recordMissing: The tool record of this run was not found (it may have been cleaned up): what ran is not known
result.writesFailed: No successful write recorded, every attempt failed: {{files}}
result.writesRefused: No successful write recorded, not allowed: {{files}}
result.shellMayWrite: Shell commands may have changed files too; this list covers file tools only.
result.commandSummary_one: {{count}} command · {{failed}} failed ({{fixed}} succeeded later) · {{unknown}} without a recorded result
result.commandSummary_other: {{count}} commands · {{failed}} failed ({{fixed}} succeeded later) · {{unknown}} without a recorded result
result.notListed: Failures are always listed; of the other commands only the latest are shown. All of them are in Logs.
result.writtenThenFailed: Written, but a later attempt failed (the earlier change stays): {{files}}
result.filesNotListed_one: … {{count}} more file without a recorded successful write is not listed; all are in Logs.
result.filesNotListed_other: … {{count}} more files without a recorded successful write are not listed; all are in Logs.
result.failedNotListed_one: {{count}} more failed command is not listed; all are in Logs.
result.failedNotListed_other: {{count}} more failed commands are not listed; all are in Logs.
